name: HTN02a: Newly Diagnosed Hypertension
description:
Number of active ART clients newly diagnosed with Hypertension during the reporting quarter.
The HTN status must indicate Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification or Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification and Medication. These are explicit HTN status values.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.htn_status IN (
      'Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification',
      'Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification and Medication'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
